context: Marketplace SaaS with Dashboard for Social Media Accounts

sizing.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-black uppercase text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-primary to-accent
sizing.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-bold uppercase

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy_marketing: MODE A: THE TETRIS GRID (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8)
layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy_dashboard: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6)

components.button_primary: bg-primary text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-6 py-3 border border-transparent hover:bg-white hover:text-black hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,240,255,0.6)] transition-all duration-300
components.button_secondary: bg-transparent text-primary font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-6 py-3 border border-primary/50 hover:border-primary hover:bg-primary/10 transition-all duration-300
components.input: bg-black/50 border border-primary/30 text-white px-4 py-3 focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 rounded-none w-full
components.navigation: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-primary/20
components.badge: bg-primary/10 text-primary border border-primary/30 uppercase text-xs font-mono tracking-widest px-2 py-1 inline-block
components.table_header: border-b border-primary/30 text-text_secondary font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wider py-3

hero_background.description: Abstract purple grid pattern with glowing lines

hero_mascot.description: A futuristic robot dressed in sci-fi armor illuminated by vibrant neon lights

decorative_neon.description: blue, red and pink abstract artwork

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup tailwind.config.js with the provided colors (primary: #00F0FF, secondary: #FF0055, etc) and fonts (Unbounded, Chivo, JetBrains Mono).
2. Add Google Fonts links for Unbounded, Chivo, and JetBrains Mono in index.html.
3. Build the marketing Landing Page using 'MODE A: THE TETRIS GRID' layout. Use the hero_background as a dark overlay section, and hero_mascot in a prominent position.
4. Develop the Dashboard using 'MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID' with a collapsible left sidebar.
5. Implement all required features: Marketplace browse (with filters), Listing detail, Escrow UI, Chat UI, Add Funds modal, Admin panel, and Auth pages.
6. Do not use generic Shadcn cards out-of-the-box. Customize them with sharp corners (rounded-none), 1px border-primary/20, and glassmorphism where appropriate.
7. Every interactive element MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='buy-now-button').
8. Ensure high contrast for text; use text_secondary (#A0AEC0) for body and text_primary (#FFFFFF) for headings.
9. Strictly follow mobile-first responsive design principles.
